## Fixes

- **Missing icons.** The icons on each port row (open, pin, edit, details,
  close) were built outside the SVG namespace, so browsers never drew them.
  They render again. The close icon now shows on every row, not only the last.

## Panel

- **Open in a new tab.** Each port has a visible "Open" button, and its URL is
  a link too. Both open in a new tab.
- **Full height.** The panel fills the window. The list scrolls on its own and
  the footer stays at the bottom, even with few ports.
- **Redesign.** Ports are shown as cards with real borders and shadows.
  Weights are heavier, icons are larger, and buttons have bigger hit targets.
  Tabs are a pill bar with counts, and the status strip shows four cards.
  A violet accent sets the color, with tinted badges for live, waiting and
  stopped, at WCAG AA contrast in dark and light.
- **Motion.** New ports slide in and closed ones fade out. Cards and buttons
  lift on hover and menus open smoothly. The live and tunnel dots pulse.
  Everything stays still when the system asks for reduced motion.
